snippet.title: One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 - Legend Dawn Pack - DLC Character Pack 6 Trailer | PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/one-piece--pirate-warriors-4/

Hahaha! Fights to the death are how I feel alive! Legend Dawn Pack – featuring Gol.D.Roger, Silvers.Rayleigh, and Monkey.D.Garp – is available now in ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4!

Pick it up today as part of ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 — Character Pass 2.

Character Pass 2 also comes with a bonus Onigashima Battle costume for Trafalgar Law!

#ps4games #ps4 #OPPW4 #ONEPIECE
